basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Jodhpur Research Internship for BNYS Students Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: BNYS graduates nominated by the Head of their institute or university can take a 3-month research internship at the Collaborative Centre for Mind-Body Interventions through Yoga (CCMBIY), All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Jodhpur. Two interns are taken per cycle, no stipend or financial support is given, and the third cycle starts on 1 December 2026. The nomination and application form are to be submitted to [email protected] on or before 25 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Ask the Head of your institute or university to nominate you, using the prescribed nomination letter format on the institution's official letterhead.

Fill in the Application Form for Short-Term Research Internship (Up to 3 Months), which asks for name, date of birth, addresses, contact details, citizenship, academic qualification, nominating institution, purpose or area of interest, experience, and internship start and end dates.
Sign the declaration on the form.
Email the nomination along with the application form to [email protected] on or before 25 November 2026.
Letter of nomination from the institution
Statement of Purpose (SoP) of the student
Self-attested copy of BNYS degree / academic transcript
Identity certificate (the form names Aadhaar/Passport and the Institutional ID)
important_instructions: All original documents should be brought for verification during joining. In case of any discrepancy, the candidature will be cancelled. The application form declaration says the applicant has read and understood the Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and agrees to abide by the rules and regulations of CCMBIY, AIIMS Jodhpur, during the internship period. The nomination letter also records that the student agrees to comply with institutional rules, research ethics and responsibilities.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Research Internship for BNYS Students at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Jodhpur
Collaborative Centre for Mind-Body Interventions through Yoga (CCMBIY)

content_sections.heading: About the Centre
content_sections.text: CCMBIY is the Collaborative Centre for Mind-Body Interventions through Yoga at AIIMS Jodhpur. The notice is issued by Dr. Naveen K H, PI-CCMBIY, Additional Professor, Department of CMFM, AIIMS Jodhpur. The internship is a short-term research programme for BNYS graduates.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice invites eligible and interested BNYS (Bachelor of Naturopathy and Yogic Sciences) graduates. A candidate must be nominated by the Head of the institute or university. The nomination letter is printed on the institution's letterhead and states that the student meets the eligibility criteria of the programme. A registration certificate from the State or National AYUSH Council is among the documents to be attached. For eligibility details beyond this, refer to the official notification and the SOPs it mentions.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The internship lasts 3 months, and the application form is titled for a short-term internship of up to 3 months. No stipend or financial support is given. The declaration in the application form states that the internship does not constitute employment with the institute.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Jodhpur Research Internship for BNYS Students
content_sections.text: Ask the Head of your institute or university to nominate you, using the prescribed nomination letter format on the institution's official letterhead. Fill in the Application Form for Short-Term Research Internship (Up to 3 Months), which asks for name, date of birth, addresses, contact details, citizenship, academic qualification, nominating institution, purpose or area of interest, experience, and internship start and end dates. Sign the declaration on the form. Attach the documents listed below. Email the nomination along with the application form to [email protected] on or before 25 November 2026. Letter of nomination from the institution Statement of Purpose (SoP) of the student Curriculum Vitae of the student Self-attested copy of BNYS degree / academic transcript Registration certificate (State/National AYUSH Council) Identity certificate (the form names Aadhaar/Passport and the Institutional ID) Institute ID Any other supporting documents (if applicable)

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: All original documents should be brought for verification during joining. In case of any discrepancy, the candidature will be cancelled. The application form declaration says the applicant has read and understood the Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and agrees to abide by the rules and regulations of CCMBIY, AIIMS Jodhpur, during the internship period. The nomination letter also records that the student agrees to comply with institutional rules, research ethics and responsibilities.

faq.question: Q1. How many interns will AIIMS Jodhpur CCMBIY take?
faq.answer: The intake is 02 interns per cycle.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit nominations?
faq.answer: Nominations should be submitted on or before 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the AIIMS Jodhpur research internship?
faq.answer: The notice invites eligible and interested BNYS (Bachelor of Naturopathy and Yogic Sciences) graduates, who must be nominated by the Head of their institute or university.

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send the nomination, along with the application form in the prescribed format, by email to [email protected] on or before 25 November 2026.

faq.answer: No. The notice states "No stipend / financial support".

faq.answer: The third cycle starts from 1 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is this internship a job at AIIMS Jodhpur?
faq.answer: No. The application form declaration states that the internship/training does not constitute employment with the institute.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents must be attached?
faq.answer: The nomination letter, Statement of Purpose, CV, self-attested BNYS degree or transcript, AYUSH Council registration certificate, identity certificate, institute ID and any other supporting documents if applicable.

faq.question: Q10. What happens to original documents?
faq.answer: All original documents should be brought for verification during joining, and any discrepancy leads to cancellation of the candidature.
